name: Gilded Blade
cardText: Select an enemy follower on the field. Deal it 2 damage and, if there are at least 10 cards in opponents' cemeteries, deal 2 damage to its leader.

name: Gilded Goblet
cardText: Give your leader [defense]+1. If there are at least 10 cards in opponents' cemeteries, give [defense]+2 instead.

name: Gilded Boots
cardText: Select a Thief follower on your field and give it Rush. If there are at least 10 cards in opponents' cemeteries, give Storm instead.
